description: Horizontal rollout of the entries pilot pattern (established in FEAT-002) to the remaining backend features, in the design §10 order: auth -> tournaments -> teams -> data -> notifications. Each sub-phase produces that feature's domain/ (entities/VO/domain services + Repository interface), infrastructure/ (Sqlite<Entity>Repository), application/ (Application/Query service), and thins its Server Actions to adapters, preserving external contracts and wiring through src/server/container.ts. Key design-locked moves: GranLevel (from auth/utils/classLabel.ts) goes DIRECTLY to src/domain/GranLevel.ts (shared foundation, §8-3) so data references the shared base and the current data->auth cross-import is eliminated; GranLevelAssignmentService (from auth/utils/level.ts, median-only CLASS_RANGE, NOT tier boundaries) goes to auth/domain; Tournament entity absorbs capacity.ts (remaining/capacityStatus) while TournamentWithStats/TournamentCardData keep remaining:number and capacityStatus plain across the boundary; data's dataViewData.ts becomes DataViewService with RankingService/LevelDistributionService/EntryHistoryService/PeriodFilterService/TeamRatingService. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 (reuses DomainError, UoW, container, CategoryRules, and the proven adapter pattern).
steps: Read docs/oop-architecture.md §5 (full move mapping), §8 (cross-import OOP rules + §8-3 GranLevel placement), §2.1 (Tournament DTO boundary rule), and the actual source files per sub-phase FIRST. Reuse FEAT-002's patterns; do not re-decide architecture.

auth: create src/domain/GranLevel.ts (VO: 100..999 integer, toTier() with the lower-bound boundaries from classLabel.ts 850/750/650/550/450/350/250/else DE, toClassLabel() => `${toTier()}級`); auth/domain/GranLevelAssignmentService.ts (estimateInitialGranLevel: keep CLASS_RANGE median + Math.max(100,Math.min(999,Math.round((min+max)/2))), then build GranLevel; CLASS_RANGE stays separate from toTier boundaries — do NOT unify); auth/domain/UserRepository.ts interface + auth/infrastructure/SqliteUserRepository.ts (move userRepository.ts SQL + row->User); auth/application/AuthApplicationService.ts (register/login/logout, login failure stays generic/no user enumeration) and auth/application/CurrentUserService.ts (move currentUser.ts getCurrentUser/toCurrentUser, toCurrentUser uses GranLevel.toClassLabel()); thin auth/server/actions.ts adapter keeping AuthActionState contract. Keep classLabel.ts as a thin re-export/delegation to GranLevel until all callers migrate, or update callers directly. Update src/features/data/utils/__tests__/tier.test.ts import of granLevelToTier to the new src/domain/GranLevel source. Wire auth factories in container.ts.

tournaments: create Tournament entity (tournaments/domain) absorbing capacity.ts calcRemaining/calcCapacityStatus as remaining(confirmedCount)/capacityStatus(confirmedCount), plus isOpen() (status==='OPEN'), canAcceptEntry(confirmedCount); finalize CategoryRules in tournaments/domain (already created in FEAT-002) and remove tournaments/utils/category.ts + capacity.ts delegations once callers migrate; TournamentRepository interface + SqliteTournamentRepository (move tournamentRepository.ts incl. findTournamentWithStats); a TournamentQueryService for read views. CRITICAL: Server Action/view return values stay plain TournamentWithStats/TournamentCardData with remaining:number and capacityStatus:'OPEN'|'FEW'|'FULL' — the entity computes them but an adapter/query service converts entity->DTO; never pass a Tournament instance or method to a Client Component or across 'use server' (useTournamentFilters.ts reads t.capacityStatus; ScheduleCards/ScheduleTable/GuidelinesViewer read t.remaining).

teams: TeamRepository interface + SqliteTeamRepository (move teamRepository.ts findTeamById/findTeamByLeader + row->Team); Team entity if the design assigns invariants, else keep the DTO and just wrap the repository. Replace the minimal TeamRepository shim that FEAT-002 created with the real one and re-point container.ts.

data: create data/domain Domain Services RankingService (rankUsers + team ranking integration absorbing buildTeamRanking; buildSelfRankSummary as a private), LevelDistributionService (buildDistribution), EntryHistoryService (sortEntries/filterEntries), PeriodFilterService (periodLowerBound), TeamRatingService (computeTeamRating); data/application/DataViewService.ts (buildDataViewData as the single public method; keep exported DataViewData type, move it to DataViewService.ts or data/types); DataRepository interface + SqliteDataRepository (move dataRepository.ts SELECTs + tournamentResultsGuard.ts fallback as private). data must reference src/domain/GranLevel (NOT auth/domain) — this closes the data->auth cross-import. Migrate data/utils/__tests__ (ranking/distribution/entryHistory/teamRating/tier) to call the new service methods; keep fast-check properties.

notifications: NotificationRepository interface + SqliteNotificationRepository (move notificationRepository.ts logNotification) and a NotificationService; replace the FEAT-002 shim and re-point container.ts so EntryApplicationService's notification dependency uses the real NotificationService.

After each sub-phase, update src/server/container.ts wiring to the real Sqlite implementations and remove any temporary shims introduced in FEAT-002. Keep feature-to-feature imports to published interfaces/domain types only (no Sqlite* new'd outside container.ts).

Run the full verification after EACH sub-phase (auth, then tournaments, then teams, then data, then notifications) so a regression is caught at the smallest step; commit per sub-phase with a Conventional Commit (refactor(auth): ..., refactor(tournaments): ..., etc.).
acceptance_criteria: GranLevel lives at src/domain/GranLevel.ts; data imports it from src/domain (no data->auth cross-import remains); CLASS_RANGE (assignment) and toTier() boundaries remain separate definitions.

TournamentWithStats/TournamentCardData still expose remaining:number and capacityStatus:'OPEN'|'FEW'|'FULL' as plain fields across 'use server'; no entity/method crosses the boundary (useTournamentFilters + ScheduleCards/ScheduleTable/GuidelinesViewer unchanged).
AuthActionState, DataViewData, and all other Server Action contracts are unchanged; login failure wording stays generic.
All migrated data/utils tests (incl. fast-check tier/ranking/distribution properties) pass against the new service methods; tier.test.ts imports the new GranLevel source.
DB schema unchanged; no any; SQL only in Sqlite*Repository classes; no cross-feature import of Sqlite* implementations.
After every sub-phase: npx tsc --noEmit exits 0, npm test passes, npm run build succeeds (external SQLite-lock caveat per context.json).
verification: Per sub-phase: npx vitest run src/features/<f>  then  npm test  (expect all pass, Property 7 still passes)
npx tsc --noEmit  (expect exit 0) after each sub-phase
npm run build  (expect success; apply external-lock caveat on SQLite 'database is locked')
findings:
横展開（auth -> tournaments -> teams -> data -> notifications）を設計 §10 の順で完了。各サブフェーズ後に 3 ゲートを実行し、すべて green（npm test=88 passed/16 files・Property 7 も毎回 pass / npx tsc --noEmit=exit0 / npm run build=成功: 今回は外部 SQLite ロックに阻まれなかった）。サブフェーズごとに Conventional Commit で 5 コミット（refactor(auth)/refactor(tournaments)/refactor(teams)/refactor(data)/refactor(notifications)）。

【後続 FEAT が従うパターン・配線状況】
- container.ts は entries の最小依存（TournamentView/TeamView/UserView/NotificationService）を、いまや本物の Sqlite*Repository / NotificationService へ委譲する薄いアダプタとして配線済み。FEAT-002 のスタブ（findTournamentWithStats 由来の容量派生ロジック・logNotification 直呼び）はすべて置換済み。entries 側は無改修。
- クロス feature import は published interface / domain 型のみ（§8 一方向）。Sqlite* の new は各 feature 自身の server 委譲ラッパ内か container.ts のみ（feature を跨いだ Sqlite* の new/ import は無し）。

【GranLevel（共有基盤・§8-3）】
- src/domain/GranLevel.ts に VO を直接配置（100..999 整数・範囲外は RangeError）。toTier() は classLabel.ts の下限境界（850/750/650/550/450/350/250/else DE）を 1:1 保存、toClassLabel()=`${toTier()}級`。
- auth/utils/classLabel.ts は GranLevel への薄い委譲ラッパとして残置（AppShell.tsx が granLevelToClassLabel を、まだ参照しているため撤去していない。フロント統一フェーズで解消可）。
- data は src/domain/GranLevel を参照し data->auth のクロス import を解消（RankingService/LevelDistributionService および dataRepository.ranking.test.ts も GranLevel 経由へ移行）。
- 算出用レンジ（GranLevelAssignmentService の CLASS_RANGE 中央値、Math.round→clamp 100..999）と判定用 toTier() 境界は別定義のまま（統一禁止を順守）。

【tournaments 境界ルール（§2.1）】
- Tournament エンティティが remaining(confirmedCount)/capacityStatus(confirmedCount)/isOpen()/canAcceptEntry(confirmedCount) を保持（capacity.ts を吸収）。CapacityStatus 型はエンティティに一本化し capacity.ts が re-export。
- SqliteTournamentRepository が row->Tournament を rehydrate し、TournamentWithStats はエンティティのメソッドで派生値を算出した上で『プレーン DTO（remaining:number / capacityStatus:'OPEN'|'FEW'|'FULL'）』へ変換して返す。エンティティ/メソッドは 'use server' 境界・Client Component を越えない（useTournamentFilters + ScheduleCards/ScheduleTable/GuidelinesViewer は無改修）。
- TournamentQueryService が読み取りビュー（listPublic / findWithStats）を提供。tournamentRepository.ts は listPublicTournaments / findTournamentWithStats の薄い委譲ラッパへ縮退。

【teams / data / notifications】
- Team は不変条件が設計上割り当てられていないため DTO のまま。TeamRepository interface + SqliteTeamRepository で取得を抽象化。
- data: RankingService（rankUsers + buildTeamRanking を吸収、buildSelfRankSummary は同クラスのメソッドとして同居し DataViewService が呼ぶ）/ LevelDistributionService / EntryHistoryService / PeriodFilterService / TeamRatingService。DataViewService.buildDataViewData が単一公開メソッド。DataViewData 型は DataViewService.ts に移し dataViewData.ts が re-export（DataTabView.tsx / data page の import パスは不変）。
- notifications: NotificationRepository interface + SqliteNotificationRepository + NotificationService。notificationRepository.ts は logNotification + 型の薄い委譲ラッパへ縮退。

【外部契約・ビヘイビア保存】
- AuthActionState / DataViewData / TournamentWithStats / TournamentCardData の形は不変。ログイン失敗文言は汎用のまま（AuthApplicationService は invalidCredentials/locked/suspended/authenticated の判別ユニオンを返し、存在有無を区別しない。Cookie 発行・redirect・文言マップはアダプタ actions.ts が担当）。DB スキーマ無変更・no any・SQL は Sqlite*Repository のみ。

【削除/残置（意図的）】
- 削除: auth/utils/level.ts（呼び出し元が無くなったため。ロジックは GranLevelAssignmentService へ移設）。
- 残置（薄い委譲ラッパ）: auth/{classLabel.ts, server/userRepository.ts, server/currentUser.ts}, tournaments/{utils/category.ts, utils/capacity.ts, server/tournamentRepository.ts}, teams/server/teamRepository.ts, data/{server/dataRepository.ts, server/dataViewData.ts, utils/{ranking,distribution,teamRating,entryHistory,period}.ts}, notifications/server/notificationRepository.ts。いずれも『OOP 化前のクライアント/他 feature/既存統合テストの呼び出し元が残っている』ため削除せず SQL を層外へ出した委譲として残置。
- data/server/tournamentResultsGuard.ts は dataRepository.fallback.test.ts が safeQuery を直接 import しているため残置（フォールバックは SqliteDataRepository の private にも実装済み）。

【未着手（本 FEAT の範囲外）】
- entryRepository.ts（listInvolvedTournamentIds を tournaments/page.tsx が import）と entryViewData.ts（findUserById / findTeamByLeader / findTeamWithMembers を参照）は依然 server 委譲ラッパ経由で生存。tournaments/utils/category.ts のクライアント呼び出し元（EntryModal/WaitlistModal/GuidelinesViewer）と AppShell.tsx の classLabel 参照はフロント統一フェーズで移行可能。これらは behavior-preserving のため本 FEAT では触れていない。
